CustomField.label: Event
CustomField.description: Lookup to the Event__c record this donation or income is attributed to. This must be a Lookup (not Master-Detail) as Salesforce does not permit Master-Detail on the standard Opportunity object. As a result, Event__c.Total_Donations__c cannot be a Roll-Up Summary and is instead maintained by a Flow in Epic 4.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Link this donation to a specific charity event for income attribution and fundraising performance reporting. Leave blank for donations not associated with an event.
